title: Health insurance coverage: explicit ACS releases
description: All Ohio counties plus the one-year and five-year statewide comparison.
methodology: Civilian noninstitutionalized population, not the population for whom poverty status is determined. B27001 point estimates are redistributed by Census Reporter; all original estimates, margins of error and metadata remain retained.

source.title: ACS 2024 B27001: health insurance by sex and age
source.publisher: U.S. Census Bureau; Census Reporter redistribution
source.locator: Full B27001 table, geography and release metadata
source.note: Primary S2701 definitions and the one-year total corroborate the universe; derived B27001 proportions remain labeled.
source.rights: Attributed statistical facts; original publisher rights remain with its source.
